m: ulba or ulva (rarely as, m.), am, n. (√ uc, ‘to accumulate’, Uṇ. iv, 95; more probably fr. √ vṛ, BRD.), a cover, envelope, esp. the membrane surrounding the embryo, RV. x, 51, 1; AV. iv, 2, 8; VS.; TS.; ŚBr. &c.; the vulva, womb, VS. xix, 76; a cave, cavity, L.; [cf. Lat. alvus, vulva; Lith. urwā, üla.]
a: ulbaṃ, -lvaṃ 1 The bag which surrounds the embryo, fœtus. 2 The vulva. 3 The womb. 4 A cave.
